synopsis: IEC 61496 is the IEC series for electro-sensitive protective equipment (ESPE), including light curtains and laser scanners; IEC TS 61496-5:2023 covers radar protective devices that stop a factory machine when someone enters a zone [f15018, f15277]. Together with IEC TS 62998, it provides an established certification basis for non-contact safety sensors and component-level detection capability [f1038, f12388, f15276]. Chapter 1 presents qualification under these standards as a way to shorten validation of perception-dependent safety functions [f437]. However, these are neighboring-sector factory-sensor standards, and the radar part explicitly does not consider aspects of a moving radar protective device application, limiting what certification alone establishes for mobile-machine use [f15276, f15278]. The corpus also records an unresolved choice between keeping machine learning outside the safety function and using certified deterministic sensors, or accepting machine learning through ISO/PAS 8800-style assurance [f1125].
